description: Forty years after fleeing Iran, Maryam has never been able to return home. Instead, she creates a fragile bridge across continents: surveillance cameras installed in her parents’ house in Tehran stream their everyday lives into her room in America. But when war and political tensions sever Iran’s internet connection, the screens go dark and her last digital link to home disappears. Blending documentary, personal archives, and visual poetry, the film asks whether technology can truly preserve intimacy, or if it is the very reason for all these distances.
